verses.text: After di death of Joshua, di pikin dem of Israel ask di Lord, talk say, “Who go go up for us first against di Canaanites, to fight dem?”
Di Lord talk say, “Judah go go up. Look, I don deliver di land into im hand.”
Judah talk to Simeon im brother, “Come up with me into my lot, so that we fit fight against di Canaanites. Den I go go with you into your lot too.” So Simeon go with am.
Judah go up, and di Lord deliver di Canaanites and di Perizzites into dem hand. Dem strike 10,000 men of dem for Bezek.
Dem find Adoni-Bezek for Bezek, and dem fight against am, and dem strike di Canaanites and di Perizzites.
But Adoni-Bezek run, and dem chase am, catch am, and cut off im thumbs and im big toes.
Adoni-Bezek talk say, “70 kings, wey dem don cut off dem thumbs and dem big toes, dey gather dem food under my table. As I do, so God don pay me back.” Dem bring am to Jerusalem, and e die dere.
Di pikin dem of Judah fight against Jerusalem, take am, strike am with di edge of di sword, and set di city on fire.
After dat, di pikin dem of Judah go down to fight di Canaanites wey dey live for di hill country, for di South and for di lowland.
Judah go against di Canaanites wey dey live for Hebron. Di name of Hebron before na Kiriath-Arba. Dem strike Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
From dere dem go against di people wey dey live for Debir. Di name of Debir before na Kiriath-Sepher.
Caleb talk say, “Anybody wey strike Kiriath-Sepher and take am, I go give am Achsah my pikin woman as wife.”
Othniel di pikin of Kenaz, Caleb younger brother, take am. Caleb give am Achsah im pikin woman as wife.
When Achsah come to Othniel, e push am to ask im papa for one field. Achsah come down from di donkey, and Caleb talk to am, “Wetin you want?”
Achsah talk to am, “Give me blessing. Because you don put me for di land of di South, give me springs of water too.” Caleb give am di upper springs and di lower springs.
Di pikin dem of di Kenite, Moses wife papa, go up from di city of palm trees with di pikin dem of Judah into di wilderness of Judah, wey dey di south of Arad. Dem go dwell among di people.
Judah go with Simeon im brother, and dem strike di Canaanites wey dey live for Zephath, and utterly destroy am. Dem call di name of di city Hormah.
Judah take Gaza with im border, Ashkelon with im border and Ekron with im border too.
Di Lord dey with Judah, and e take possession of di hill country. But e no fit drive out di people wey dey live for di valley, because dem get iron chariots.
Dem give Hebron to Caleb, as Moses talk, and e drive out from dere di three pikin man dem of Anak.
Di pikin dem of Benjamin no drive out di Jebusites wey dey live for Jerusalem, but di Jebusites dey live with di pikin dem of Benjamin for Jerusalem till dis day.
Di house of Joseph go up against Bethel too, and di Lord dey with dem.
Di house of Joseph send people to spy Bethel. Di name of di city before na Luz.
Di watchers see one man wey dey come out of di city, and dem talk to am, “Please show us di entrance into di city, and we go show you kindness.”
E show dem di entrance into di city, and dem strike di city with di edge of di sword. But dem let di man and all im family go.
Di man go into di land of di Hittites, build one city, and call im name Luz. Dat na im name till dis day.

Manasseh no drive out di people wey dey live for Beth-shean and im towns, nor Taanach and im towns, nor di people wey dey live for Dor and im towns, nor di people wey dey live for Ibleam and im towns, nor di people wey dey live for Megiddo and im towns. But di Canaanites insist to dwell for dat land.
When Israel grow strong, dem put di Canaanites for forced labour, but dem no utterly drive dem out.
Ephraim no drive out di Canaanites wey dey live for Gezer, but di Canaanites dey live for Gezer among dem.
Zebulun no drive out di people of Kitron, nor di people of Nahalol. But di Canaanites dey live among dem, and dem become forced labourers.
Asher no drive out di people of Acco, nor di people of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob.
But di Asherites dey live among di Canaanites, di people wey dey live for di land, because dem no drive dem out.

Naphtali no drive out di people of Beth-shemesh, nor di people of Beth-anath, but e dey live among di Canaanites, di people wey dey live for di land. Even so, di people of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath become forced labourers for dem.
Di Amorites force di pikin dem of Dan enter di hill country, because dem no allow dem to come down to di valley,
but di Amorites insist to dwell for Mount Heres, for Aijalon and for Shaalbim. Still, di hand of di house of Joseph win, so tay dem become forced labourers.
Di border of di Amorites na from di ascent of Akrabbim, from di rock, and go up.

Di angel of di Lord go up from Gilgal to Bochim. E talk say, “I bring una out of Egypt, and I don bring una to di land wey I swear to una papa dem. I talk say, ‘I no go ever break my covenant with una.
Una no go make any covenant with di people wey dey live for dis land. Una go break down dem altars.’ But una no listen to my voice. Why una do dis?
So I talk too say, ‘I no go drive dem out from before una, but dem go dey for una sides, and dem gods go be snare to una.’”
When di angel of di Lord speak dis words to all di pikin dem of Israel, di people lift up dem voice, and weep.
Dem call di name of dat place Bochim. Dem offer sacrifice dere to di Lord.
Now when Joshua don send di people away, di pikin dem of Israel go, each one to im inheritance, to possess di land.
Di people serve di Lord all di days of Joshua, and all di days of di elders wey outlive Joshua, wey don see all di great work of di Lord, wey e do for Israel.
Joshua di pikin of Nun, di servant of di Lord, die, wey don reach 110 years old.
Dem bury am for di border of im inheritance for Timnath-heres, for di hill country of Ephraim, for di north of di mountain of Gaash.
All dat generation join dem papa dem too. Another generation rise after dem, wey no know di Lord, nor di work wey e do for Israel.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord, and serve di Baals.

Dem leave di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, wey bring dem out of di land of Egypt, and follow other gods, among di gods of di peoples wey dey round dem, and bow down to dem. Dem provoke di Lord to anger.
Dem leave di Lord, and serve Baal and di Ashtaroth.

Di anger of di Lord burn against Israel, and e deliver dem into di hands of plunderers wey plunder dem. E sell dem into di hands of dem enemies round about, so tay dem no fit stand before dem enemies again.
Anywhere dem go, di hand of di Lord dey against dem for evil, as di Lord speak, and as di Lord swear to dem. Dem dey in great distress.
Di Lord raise up judges, wey save dem out of di hand of dem wey plunder dem.

But dem no listen to dem judges, because dem dey play di prostitute after other gods, and bow down to dem. Dem turn away quick from di way wey dem papa dem waka, wey dey obey di commandments of di Lord. Dem no do so.

When di Lord raise up judges for dem, di Lord dey with di judge, and save dem out of di hand of dem enemies all di days of di judge, because di Lord feel sorry because of dem groaning, because of dem wey oppress dem and trouble dem.
But e happen say, when di judge die, dem turn back, and behave pass dem papa dem for corruption, to follow other gods, serve dem and bow down to dem. Dem no stop dem doings, nor dem stubborn way.
Di anger of di Lord burn against Israel, and e talk say, “Because dis nation don break my covenant wey I command dem papa dem, and no listen to my voice,
I no go again drive out from before dem any of di nations wey Joshua leave when e die,
so that by dem I go test Israel, whether dem go keep di way of di Lord to waka inside am, as dem papa dem keep am, or no.”
So di Lord leave dem nations, and no drive dem out quick. E no deliver dem into di hand of Joshua too.
Dis na di nations wey di Lord leave, to test Israel by dem, even all wey no know di wars of Canaan,
only so that di generations of di pikin dem of Israel go know, to teach dem war, at least dem wey no know anything of am before.
Dem na di five lords of di Philistines, and all di Canaanites, and di Sidonians, and di Hivites wey dey live for Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to di entrance of Hamath.
Dem remain to test Israel by dem, to know whether dem go obey di commandments of di Lord, wey e command dem papa dem by Moses.
Di pikin dem of Israel dey live among di Canaanites, di Hittites, di Amorites, di Perizzites, di Hivites and di Jebusites.
Dem take dem pikin woman dem as wives, and give dem own pikin woman dem to dem pikin man dem, and serve dem gods.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord, and forget di Lord dem God, and serve di Baals and di Asherim.
So di anger of di Lord burn against Israel, and e sell dem into di hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia. Di pikin dem of Israel serve Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.
When di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord, di Lord raise up one saviour for di pikin dem of Israel, wey save dem, na Othniel di pikin of Kenaz, Caleb younger brother.
Spirit of di Lord come on am, and e judge Israel. E go out to war, and di Lord deliver Cushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into im hand, and im hand win against Cushan-rishathaim.
Di land get rest for 40 years. Den Othniel di pikin of Kenaz die.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord again, and di Lord make Eglon di king of Moab strong against Israel, because dem do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord.
E gather di pikin dem of Ammon and Amalek to imself, and e go strike Israel, and dem possess di city of palm trees.
Di pikin dem of Israel serve Eglon di king of Moab for 18 years.

But when di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord, di Lord raise up one saviour for dem, Ehud di pikin of Gera, di Benjamite, one left-handed man. Di pikin dem of Israel send tribute by am to Eglon di king of Moab.
Ehud make one sword for imself wey get two edges, one cubit long, and e tie am under im clothes on im right thigh.
E bring di tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon na very fat man.
When e finish to bring di tribute, e send away di people wey carry di tribute.
But e imself turn back from di idols wey dey near Gilgal, and talk say, “I get secret message for you, king.” Di king talk say, “Keep quiet!” All wey stand near am go out from am.
Ehud come to am, wey dey sit by imself alone for di cool upper room. Ehud talk say, “I get message from God for you.” E rise up from im seat.
Ehud stretch out im left hand, take di sword from im right thigh, and push am inside im belly.
Di handle enter after di blade too, and di fat close on di blade, because e no pull di sword out of im belly. E come out behind.
Den Ehud go out to di porch, shut di doors of di upper room on am, and lock dem.
When e don go out, im servants come. Dem see say, look, di doors of di upper room don lock. Dem talk say, “Surely e dey cover im feet for di upper room.”
Dem wait till shame catch dem. Look, e no open di doors of di upper room, so dem take di key and open dem. Look, dem oga fall down dead on di ground.
Ehud escape while dem dey wait, pass di idols, and escape to Seirah.
E happen say when e reach, e blow trumpet for di hill country of Ephraim, and di pikin dem of Israel go down with am from di hill country, with am for front of dem.

E talk to dem say, “Follow me, because di Lord don deliver una enemies di Moabites into una hand.” Dem go down follow am, take di fords of di Jordan against di Moabites, and no allow any man pass over.
Dem strike about 10,000 men of Moab for dat time, every strong man and every man of valour, and no man escape.
So Moab come under di hand of Israel dat day. Di land get rest for 80 years.
After am na Shamgar di pikin of Anath, wey strike 600 men of di Philistines with ox goad. E save Israel too.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord again, when Ehud don die.
Di Lord sell dem into di hand of Jabin king of Canaan, wey dey reign for Hazor. Di captain of im army na Sisera, wey dey live for Harosheth of di Gentiles.
Di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord, because e get 900 iron chariots, and e oppress di pikin dem of Israel hard for 20 years.
Now Deborah, one prophetess, Lappidoth wife, dey judge Israel for dat time.
E dey sit under Deborah palm tree between Ramah and Bethel for di hill country of Ephraim, and di pikin dem of Israel dey go up to am for judgment.

E send call Barak di pikin of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and talk to am say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, no command say, ‘Go, and lead di way to Mount Tabor, and take 10,000 men with you of di pikin dem of Naphtali and of di pikin dem of Zebulun?
I go draw Sisera, di captain of Jabin army, with im chariots and im multitude, to you for di river Kishon, and I go deliver am into your hand.’”
Barak talk to am, “If you go go with me, den I go go. But if you no go go with me, I no go go.”

E talk say, “I go go with you for sure. But di journey wey you dey take no go bring honour to you, because di Lord go sell Sisera into di hand of one woman.” Deborah rise up, and go with Barak to Kedesh.
Barak call Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh, and 10,000 men go up wey dey follow am. Deborah go up with am too.
Now Heber di Kenite don separate imself from di Kenites, even from di pikin dem of Hobab, Moses brother-in-law, and pitch im tent as far as di oak for Zaanannim, wey dey near Kedesh.
Dem tell Sisera say Barak di pikin of Abinoam don go up to Mount Tabor.
Sisera gather together all im chariots, even 900 iron chariots, and all di people wey dey with am, from Harosheth of di Gentiles to di river Kishon.
Deborah talk to Barak, “Rise up! Because dis na di day wey di Lord don deliver Sisera into your hand. Di Lord no don go out before you?” So Barak go down from Mount Tabor, and 10,000 men follow am.
Di Lord confuse Sisera, all im chariots and all im army with di edge of di sword before Barak. Sisera come down from im chariot, and run on im feet.
But Barak chase after di chariots and after di army reach Harosheth of di Gentiles. All di army of Sisera fall by di edge of di sword, and no even one man remain.
But Sisera run on im feet go di tent of Jael, Heber di Kenite wife, because peace dey between Jabin di king of Hazor and di house of Heber di Kenite.
Jael go out to meet Sisera, and talk to am, “Turn in, my oga, turn in to me. No fear.” E turn in to Jael enter di tent, and Jael cover am with one rug.
E talk to am, “Please give me small water to drink, because I dey thirsty.” Jael open one skin of milk, give am drink, and cover am.
E talk to am, “Stand for di door of di tent, and if any man come ask you say, ‘Anybody dey here?’ you go talk say, ‘No.’”
Den Jael, Heber wife, take one tent peg, take hammer for im hand, and go softly to am, and drive di peg enter im temples till e enter di ground, because e dey fast asleep and e don tire. So e die.

Look, as Barak dey chase Sisera, Jael come out to meet am, talk to am say, “Come, and I go show you di man wey you dey look for.” E come to am, and look, Sisera dey lie dead, and di tent peg dey inside im temples.
So God bring down Jabin di king of Canaan dat day before di pikin dem of Israel.
Di hand of di pikin dem of Israel dey win more and more against Jabin di king of Canaan, until dem destroy Jabin king of Canaan.
Den Deborah and Barak di pikin of Abinoam sing dat day, talk,
“Because di leaders take di lead for Israel, because di people offer demselves willingly, bless di Lord!
Hear, una kings! Give ear, una princes! I, even I, go sing to di Lord. I go sing praise to di Lord, di God of Israel.
Di Lord, when you go out from Seir, when you march out from di field of Edom, di earth shake, di sky drop water too, yes, di clouds drop water.
Di mountains shake before di Lord, even Sinai before di Lord, di God of Israel.
For di days of Shamgar di pikin of Anath, for di days of Jael, di highways dey empty, and di travellers dey waka through side roads.
Di rulers for Israel stop, dem stop until I, Deborah, rise, until I rise as mama for Israel.
Dem choose new gods. Den war dey for di gates. Dem see any shield or spear among 40,000 for Israel?
My heart dey with di governors of Israel, wey offer demselves willingly among di people. Bless di Lord!
Tell am, una wey dey ride white donkeys, una wey dey sit on rich carpets, and una wey dey waka for di way.

Far from di noise of archers, for di places wey dem dey draw water, dere dem go tell di righteous acts of di Lord, di righteous acts of im rulers for Israel. Den di people of di Lord go down to di gates.
Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, sing one song! Rise up, Barak, and lead your captives away, you pikin man of Abinoam.
Den one remnant come down, di nobles and di people. Di Lord come down for me against di mighty.
Out of Ephraim dem come down, dem wey dia root dey for Amalek. After you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Out of Machir governors come down. Out of Zebulun, dem wey hold di marshal staff.
Di princes of Issachar dey with Deborah. As Issachar dey, so Barak dey. Dem send am out on foot enter di valley. By di streams of Reuben, great decisions of heart dey.
Why you sit among di sheepfolds, to hear di whistling for di flocks? By di streams of Reuben, great searchings of heart dey.
Gilead dey live for di other side of di Jordan. Why Dan stay with ships? Asher sit still for di harbour of di sea, and stay by im creeks.
Zebulun na people wey risk dem lives to death, Naphtali too, for di high places of di field.
Di kings come and fight. Den di kings of Canaan fight, for Taanach by di waters of Megiddo. Dem no take plunder of silver.
From heaven di stars fight. From dem paths, dem fight against Sisera.
Di river Kishon sweep dem away, dat ancient river, di river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.
Den di horse hoofs stamp because of di prancing, di prancing of dem strong ones.
‘Curse Meroz,’ di angel of di Lord talk. ‘Curse di people wey dey live dere bitterly, because dem no come help di Lord, to help di Lord against di mighty.’
Jael go be blessed pass women, Heber di Kenite wife, e go be blessed pass women for di tent.
E ask for water, and e give am milk. E bring am butter for one noble bowl.
E put im hand to di tent peg, and im right hand to di workmen hammer. With di hammer e strike Sisera. E strike through im head. Yes, e pierce and strike through im temples.
For im feet e bow, e fall, e lie. For im feet e bow, e fall. Wia e bow, dere e fall down dead.
Out of di window e look, and cry, Sisera mama, out of di lattice: ‘Why im chariot dey take so long to come? Why di wheels of im chariots dey delay?’
Im wise princesses answer am, yes, e return answer to imself,

‘Dem no don find am? Dem no don divide di plunder? One lady, two ladies for every man; for Sisera, spoil of dyed garments, spoil of dyed garments wey dem embroider, dyed garments wey dem embroider on both sides, for di necks of di plunderers?’
So make all your enemies perish, di Lord, but make dem wey love am dey like di sun when e dey go out for im strength.” Di land get rest for 40 years.
Di pikin dem of Israel do wetin dey evil for di eyes of di Lord, and di Lord deliver dem into di hand of Midian for seven years.
Di hand of Midian win against Israel. Because of Midian, di pikin dem of Israel make dens for demselves for di mountains, and caves and strongholds.
E happen say, anytime Israel don plant, di Midianites go come up, with di Amalekites and di pikin dem of di east. Dem go come up against dem.
Dem camp against dem, and destroy di produce of di land, reach Gaza, and leave nothing to eat for Israel, no sheep, no ox, no donkey.
Because dem come up with dem animals and dem tents. Dem come like locusts for number. Dem and dem camels no get number. Dem come enter di land to destroy am.
Israel become very poor because of Midian, and di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord.
E happen say, when di pikin dem of Israel cry to di Lord because of Midian,
di Lord send one prophet to di pikin dem of Israel. E talk to dem, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘I bring una up from Egypt, and bring una out of di house of bondage.
I deliver una out of di hand of di Egyptians, and out of di hand of all wey oppress una, drive dem out from before una, and give una dem land.
I talk to una, “I na di Lord una God. Una no go fear di gods of di Amorites, wey una dey dwell for dem land.” But una no listen to my voice.’”
Di angel of di Lord come sit under di oak wey dey Ophrah, wey belong to Joash di Abiezrite. Im pikin man Gideon dey beat out wheat for di winepress, to hide am from di Midianites.
Di angel of di Lord appear to am, talk to am, “Di Lord dey with you, you mighty man of valour.”

Gideon talk to am, “Oh, my oga, if di Lord dey with us, why den all dis don happen to us? Wia all im wonderful works dey wey our papa dem tell us, talk say, ‘Di Lord no bring us up from Egypt?’ But now di Lord don throw us away, and deliver us into di hand of Midian.”
Di Lord look am, and talk, “Go with dis your strength, and save Israel from di hand of Midian. I no send you?”
E talk to am, “Oh, Lord, how I go save Israel? Look, my family na di poorest for Manasseh, and I na di smallest for my papa house.”
Di Lord talk to am, “Surely I go dey with you, and you go strike di Midianites as one man.”
E talk to am, “If I don find favour for your sight now, den show me one sign say na you dey talk with me.
Please no go from here until I come to you, bring out my present, and put am before you.” E talk say, “I go wait until you come back.”
Gideon go inside, prepare one young goat and unleavened cakes from one ephah of flour. E put di meat inside basket, put di broth inside pot, bring am out to am under di oak, and present am.
Di angel of God talk to am, “Take di meat and di unleavened cakes, put dem on dis rock, and pour out di broth.” E do so.

Den di angel of di Lord stretch out di end of di staff wey dey im hand, touch di meat and di unleavened cakes. Fire rise up out of di rock, and consume di meat and di unleavened cakes. Di angel of di Lord go from im sight.
Gideon see say na di angel of di Lord, and Gideon talk say, “Woe, di Lord God! Because I don see di angel of di Lord face to face.”
Di Lord talk to am, “Peace dey with you. No fear. You no go die.”
Den Gideon build one altar dere to di Lord, and call am Di Lord Na Peace. To dis day e still dey for Ophrah of di Abiezrites.

E happen for di same night say di Lord talk to am, “Take your papa bull, even di second bull wey don reach seven years, and throw down di altar of Baal wey your papa get, and cut down di Asherah wey dey near am,
and build altar to di Lord your God for di top of dis stronghold, for good order, and take di second bull, and offer burnt offering with di wood of di Asherah wey you go cut down.”
Den Gideon take ten men of im servants, and do as di Lord speak to am. Because e fear im papa house and di men of di city, e no fit do am for day, so e do am for night.
When di men of di city rise early for morning, look, di altar of Baal don break down, di Asherah wey dey near am don cut down, and dem don offer di second bull on di altar wey dem build.
Dem talk to each other, “Who do dis thing?” When dem inquire and ask, dem talk say, “Gideon di pikin of Joash do dis thing.”
Den di men of di city talk to Joash, “Bring out your pikin man, make e die, because e don break down di altar of Baal, and because e don cut down di Asherah wey dey near am.”

Joash talk to all wey stand against am, “Una go fight for Baal? Or una go save am? Anybody wey go fight for am, make dem put am to death before morning. If e na god, make e fight for imself, because somebody don break down im altar.”
So for dat day dem call am Jerub-baal, talk say, “Make Baal fight against am,” because e don break down im altar.
Den all di Midianites and di Amalekites and di pikin dem of di east gather demselves together. Dem pass over, and camp for di valley of Jezreel.
But Spirit of di Lord come on Gideon, and e blow trumpet. Abiezer gather together to follow am.
E send messengers throughout all Manasseh, and dem gather together to follow am too. E send messengers to Asher, to Zebulun and to Naphtali, and dem come up to meet dem.
Gideon talk to God, “If you go save Israel by my hand, as you don talk,
look, I go put one fleece of wool for di threshing floor. If dew dey for di fleece only, and di ground all dry, den I go know say you go save Israel by my hand, as you don talk.”
E happen so, because e rise up early di next day, press di fleece together, and wring di dew out of di fleece, one bowl full of water.

Gideon talk to God, “No make your anger burn against me, and I go speak just dis once. Please make I test am just dis once with di fleece. Make am dry for di fleece only, and make dew dey for all di ground.”
God do so for dat night, because e dry for di fleece only, and dew dey for all di ground.
Den Jerubbaal, wey be Gideon, and all di people wey dey with am, rise up early, and camp beside di spring of Harod. Di camp of Midian dey for di north side of dem, by di hill of Moreh, for di valley.
Di Lord talk to Gideon, “Di people wey dey with you too plenty for me to give di Midianites into dem hand, otherwise Israel go boast against me, talk say, ‘My own hand don save me.’
So now, announce for di ears of di people say, ‘Anybody wey dey fear and tremble, make e return and leave Mount Gilead.’” 22,000 of di people return, and 10,000 remain.

Di Lord talk to Gideon, “Di people still too plenty. Bring dem down to di water, and I go test dem for you dere. E go be say anybody wey I talk to you say, ‘Dis one go go with you,’ na dat one go go with you. And anybody wey I talk to you say, ‘Dis one no go go with you,’ dat one no go go.”
So e bring di people down to di water. Di Lord talk to Gideon, “Everybody wey lap di water with im tongue, as dog dey lap, you go put am by imself. Di same for everybody wey kneel down to drink.”
Di number of dem wey lap, put dem hand to dem mouth, na 300 men. But all di rest of di people kneel down to drink water.
Di Lord talk to Gideon, “By di 300 men wey lap I go save you, and deliver di Midianites into your hand. Make all di other people go, every man to im place.”
So di people take food for dem hand, and dem trumpets. Gideon send all di men of Israel go, every man to im tent, but e keep di 300 men. Di camp of Midian dey below am for di valley.
E happen for di same night say di Lord talk to am, “Rise up, go down enter di camp, because I don deliver am into your hand.
But if you dey fear to go down, go down go di camp with Purah your servant,
and you go hear wetin dem dey talk, and after dat your hands go strong to go down enter di camp.” Den e go down with Purah im servant to di outer part of di armed men wey dey for di camp.
Di Midianites and di Amalekites and all di pikin dem of di east spread for di valley like locusts for number. Dem camels no get number, like di sand wey dey for di seashore for number.

When Gideon reach, look, one man dey tell im friend one dream. E talk say, “Look, I dream one dream. Look, one cake of barley bread roll enter di camp of Midian, come to di tent, strike am so tay e fall, and turn am upside down, so tay di tent lie flat.”
Im friend answer, “Dis no be anything else but di sword of Gideon di pikin of Joash, one man of Israel. God don deliver Midian into im hand, with all di army.”

E happen say when Gideon hear di telling of di dream and im interpretation, e worship. E return enter di camp of Israel, and talk say, “Rise up, because di Lord don deliver di army of Midian into una hand.”
E divide di 300 men into three companies, and put trumpets and empty pitchers into di hands of all of dem, with torches inside di pitchers.
E talk to dem, “Watch me, and do di same. Look, when I reach di outer part of di camp, as I do, so una go do.
When I blow di trumpet, I and all wey dey with me, den una blow di trumpets too for every side of all di camp, and shout, ‘For di Lord and for Gideon!’”

So Gideon, and di 100 men wey dey with am, reach di outer part of di camp for di beginning of di middle watch, when dem just set di watch. Dem blow di trumpets, and break di pitchers wey dey dem hands.
Di three companies blow di trumpets, break di pitchers, hold di torches for dem left hands, and di trumpets for dem right hands to blow. Dem shout, “Di sword of di Lord and of Gideon!”
Dem stand every man for im place round di camp. All di army run, dem shout, and dem flee.
Dem blow di 300 trumpets, and di Lord set every man sword against im friend, and against all di army. Di army flee reach Beth Shittah toward Zererah, reach di border of Abelmeholah, by Tabbath.
Di men of Israel gather together from Naphtali, from Asher and from all Manasseh, and dem chase after Midian.

Gideon send messengers throughout all di hill country of Ephraim, talk say, “Come down against di Midianites, and take di waters before dem, reach Beth Barah, and di Jordan too.” So all di men of Ephraim gather together, and take di waters reach Beth Barah, and di Jordan too.

Dem catch di two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. Dem kill Oreb for di rock of Oreb, and dem kill Zeeb for di winepress of Zeeb, as dem dey chase Midian. Dem bring di heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon for di other side of di Jordan.
Di men of Ephraim talk to am, “Why you treat us so, say you no call us when you go fight Midian?” Dem quarrel with am hard.
E talk to dem, “Wetin I don do now compare to una? Di gleaning of di grapes of Ephraim no better pass di vintage of Abiezer?
God don deliver di princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb, into una hand. Wetin I fit do compare to una?” Den dem anger cool down toward am, when e talk dat.
Gideon reach di Jordan, and pass over, e and di 300 men wey dey with am, tired but dem still dey chase.
E talk to di men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to di people wey dey follow me, because dem tired, and I dey chase Zebah and Zalmunna, di kings of Midian.”
Di princes of Succoth talk say, “Zebah and Zalmunna hands don dey your hand now, so that we go give bread to your army?”
Gideon talk say, “So when di Lord don deliver Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, den I go tear your flesh with di thorns of di wilderness and with briers.”
E go up from dere to Penuel, and speak to dem di same way. Di men of Penuel answer am as di men of Succoth answer.
E speak to di men of Penuel too, talk say, “When I return in peace, I go break down dis tower.”
Now Zebah and Zalmunna dey for Karkor, and dem armies with dem, about 15,000 men, all wey remain of all di army of di pikin dem of di east. Because 120,000 men wey draw sword don fall.
Gideon go up by di way of dem wey dey live for tents for di east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and strike di army, because di army dey feel safe.
Zebah and Zalmunna run, and e chase dem. E catch di two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and e confuse all di army.
Gideon di pikin of Joash return from di battle from di ascent of Heres.
E catch one young man from di men of Succoth, and ask am questions. Di young man list for am di princes of Succoth and dem elders, 77 men.
E come to di men of Succoth, talk say, “Look Zebah and Zalmunna, wey una mock me about, talk say, ‘Zebah and Zalmunna hands don dey your hand now, so that we go give bread to your men wey tire?’”
E take di elders of di city, with thorns of di wilderness and briers, and with dem e teach di men of Succoth lesson.
E break down di tower of Penuel, and kill di men of di city.
Den e talk to Zebah and Zalmunna, “Wetin kind of men be dem wey una kill for Tabor?” Dem answer, “As you dey, so dem be. Each one look like pikin dem of one king.”
E talk say, “Dem na my brothers, di pikin man dem of my mama. As di Lord dey live, if una save dem alive, I no go kill una.”
E talk to Jether im firstborn, “Rise up, kill dem!” But di young man no draw im sword, because e dey fear, because e still dey young.

Den Zebah and Zalmunna talk say, “Rise up yourself, and fall on us, because as di man dey, so im strength dey.” Gideon rise up, kill Zebah and Zalmunna, and take di crescents wey dey di necks of dem camels.
Den di men of Israel talk to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, and your pikin man, and your grandpikin too, because you don save us out of di hand of Midian.”
Gideon talk to dem, “I no go rule over una, my pikin man no go rule over una too. Di Lord go rule over una.”
Gideon talk to dem, “I get one request for una, say una each give me di earrings from im plunder.” Dem get gold earrings, because dem na Ishmaelites.
Dem answer, “We go give dem willingly.” Dem spread one garment, and every man throw di earrings from im plunder inside am.

Di weight of di gold earrings wey e ask for na 1,700 shekels of gold, apart from di crescents, di pendants, di purple clothing wey dey di kings of Midian, and apart from di chains wey dey round dem camels necks.
Gideon make ephod from am, put am for im city, even for Ophrah. All Israel dey play di prostitute after am dere, and e become snare to Gideon and to im house.
So Midian come under di pikin dem of Israel, and dem no lift up dem heads again. Di land get rest for 40 years for di days of Gideon.
Jerubbaal di pikin of Joash go live for im own house.
Gideon get 70 pikin man dem wey come from im body, because e get plenty wives.
Im concubine wey dey Shechem born pikin man for am too, and e name am Abimelech.
Gideon di pikin of Joash die for good old age, and dem bury am for di tomb of Joash im papa, for Ophrah of di Abiezrites.
E happen say, as soon as Gideon die, di pikin dem of Israel turn again, play di prostitute after di Baals, and make Baal-Berith dem god.
Di pikin dem of Israel no remember di Lord dem God, wey deliver dem out of di hand of all dem enemies for every side,
and dem no show kindness to di house of Jerubbaal, na Gideon, according to all di goodness wey e show Israel.
